# Jacob Sidhu

> Manchester-based Cloud Engineer and Software Engineer. Designs, builds and automates secure, scalable and highly available cloud infrastructure on AWS. Open to Cloud and DevOps roles.

## Profile

- Location: Manchester, UK
- Education: BSc Software Engineering, University of Central Lancashire
- Experience: 4+ years of engineering experience, 12+ projects
- Certifications: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner; HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate

## Skills

- Cloud: AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, VPC, IAM, EKS, SQS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, Route 53)
- DevOps and IaC: Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Linux, Bash
- Software: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, REST APIs, SQL
- Architecture: distributed systems, microservices, high availability, cloud networking and security, event-driven design

## Projects

- QuizX: AWS-based distributed application using Amazon EKS, SQS and Terraform
- DockGen: AI-powered Dockerfile generator
- CDocX (in progress): AI-assisted healthcare documentation platform
- This portfolio: serverless on AWS (API Gateway, Lambda, S3, SES), deployed with Terraform and GitHub Actions
